rules.sourceFiles: non-test .ts/.tsx/.js/.jsx files outside ios/, android/ and generated or vendored directories
rules.routes: distinct route names (the constant when the name is a constant, else the literal) registered in a <X.Screen name=...> element
rules.routeSites: every <X.Screen name=...> element (one route can be registered in several navigators)
rules.screens: distinct component files registered as a route's component (resolved through the file's imports, tsconfig paths and babel aliases), navigators excluded
rules.screenDirFiles: .tsx/.jsx files under screens/ or src/screens/ (a cross-check, not a screen count)
rules.endpoints: distinct normalized paths from url: properties, RTK Query query: string returns, axios-style <client>.get/post/put/patch/delete calls, fetch() literals and url/path/endpoint variable assignments, in non-test, non-mock files; ${CONSTANT} templates resolved
rules.graphqlOperations: distinct named queries, mutations and subscriptions in gql`` tags and .graphql files
rules.events: distinct wire values of top-level members of *_EVENTS objects (when no catalog exists: distinct literals passed to logEvent/trackEvent/logScreenView)
rules.eventCatalogMembers: top-level members of *_EVENTS objects (two members may share a wire value)
rules.eventCallsOutsideCatalog: distinct literals passed to logEvent/trackEvent/logScreenView that are not a catalog wire value
rules.navigators: route components whose file itself registers routes or creates a navigator (nested stacks and tabs)
rules.dynamicRouteSites: <X.Screen> elements whose name is an expression (route.name, a map over a list), not counted as routes
rules.stringKeys: keys (nested keys flattened with '.') in i18n JSON catalogs, union of locales
rules.locales: locale files or folders in the i18n catalog
rules.storageKeys: AsyncStorage/MMKV keys (literals, or constants resolved to their literal), redux-persist keys and whitelisted slices, one row per file using keychain or secure-store APIs (one row per distinct kind and key)
rules.webLinks: absolute http(s) URLs passed to Linking.openURL, InAppBrowser.open or openBrowserAsync (help, legal and marketing pages)
rules.flags: distinct remote-config keys read with getValue/getBoolean/getString/getNumber in files that mention remoteConfig
rules.testFiles: files on test paths (__tests__, *.test.*, *.spec.*, mocks, msw handlers)
rules.maestroFlows: YAML files under a maestro folder with an appId: header
rules.packages: runtime dependencies that are React Native native modules (react-native-*, @react-native-*, @react-native-firebase/*, expo-*, ...)
rules.targets: native targets in ios/*.xcodeproj plus AndroidManifest.xml files under android/*/src/main
rules.code: scc: code lines per language, generated and vendored directories excluded; summed over programming languages only (JSON, YAML, Markdown and other data formats are listed, not counted)

notes: Routes registered with the static navigation API (createXNavigator({screens: {...}})) or built dynamically are not counted.
Endpoint paths are relative to whichever base URL the client adds; the parity check matches them by path suffix.
1 route(s) name a component that could not be resolved to a file (inline render or re-export).
